ranking.note: Raised: seed generation is the highest-consequence tool area in this category and an abandoned/hijackable source feeds stale addresses into every release's hardcoded seeds.

Raised: the solo note judged only the bitcoin-tx effect; the PR fixes silently swallowed/misspelled options and -rpcwallet routing across bitcoin-cli, bitcoin-wallet and bitcoin-tx, which is a user-visible correctness issue, not cleanup.

inconsistencies: #36106 (wrapper honours CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR/LIBEXECDIR) and #36190 (test that the Windows wrapper forwards child exit status) both touch the bitcoin wrapper and its functional test file tool_bitcoin.py; review #36106 first, since it is the fix and #36190 is follow-up coverage on #36105.

#19460 sits in an explicit chain: it depends on #10102 and #29409 and unblocks #19461. Its value is only realised once the prerequisites land, so reviewer effort here should follow those; it is ranked above the other P3 features because it gates downstream multiprocess work.
#36603 is prerequisite work for P2P UTXO set sharing (#35054); only its bitcoin-util txoutsetsummary part falls in this category, the loadtxoutset pipeline belongs to validation review.

#36608's tooling contribution (bitcoin-privbcast) is a small slice of a 121-file P2P/privacy change; most of its consequence will be judged in the networking category, so its tools-band should not be read as the PR's overall weight.
#35814 supersedes three stalled attempts at the same problem (#18606, #25243, #30860) and depends on the merged OpenRPC support in #34683 — it is the live one of that set.

#36571 (systemd hardening) and #36941 (OpenRC modernisation) address the same class of contrib/init problem; they are banded apart only because the systemd unit is used by far more deployments, not because one patch is better.
result.notes: The category has one clear security item (#36293) and one platform-breakage fix (#36106); everything else is developer- or maintainer-facing with genuinely similar consequence, which is why the P3 band is wide here rather than artificially spread.
